customManagers.description: Home Assistant add-on base images declared in build.yaml build_from (Dockerfiles use FROM ${BUILD_FROM}, so the native dockerfile manager can't see them)

packageRules.description: home-assistant/builder is deprecated. It pulls ghcr.io/home-assistant/<arch>-builder:<its own ref>, and 2026.02.1 is the last tag with a published builder image -- later tags have none, so any bump fails with 'manifest unknown'. Hold it until the workflow moves to home-assistant/builder/actions/*.
